requirement_text: The contract is accepted only with evidence from one exact candidate SHA.
evidence_ref: The three Golden Cases pass, but on an UNCOMMITTED worktree - no candidate SHA exists to accept against. Stamping is the coordinator's step at commit; until then this row cannot be PASS by its own wording.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: informational Teresa question creates zero Cases/Runs.
evidence_ref: The BACKEND guarantee is proven: the propose step digests a work order and creates ZERO Cases (case_core count asserted 0 afterwards) and ZERO Runs (data.runCreated===false). There is no Teresa/chat caller yet, so 'an informational Teresa question' cannot be driven end to end.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: direct Finance or Assessment work creates its canonical object and zero Case.
evidence_ref: No Finance or Assessment module writes through this API, so 'creates its canonical object and zero Case' has no path to exercise.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: durable Teresa request creates exactly one Case and one canonical Run under request replay.
evidence_ref: EXACTLY ONE CASE UNDER REPLAY: proven on real PG - confirm creates the Case (201, caseCreated true), the replayed confirm reuses it (200, same caseId, reused true) and case_core still holds exactly one row. ONE CANONICAL RUN: not provable, there is no canonical Run aggregate.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: restart between NodeRuns resumes from persisted state.
evidence_ref: There is no NodeRun aggregate to restart between. The nearest durable-state evidence is Golden Case C (a wait re-read through a fresh app instance and out of band from Postgres), which is adjacent but does not satisfy this row.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: duplicate dispatch/callback/approval produces one business effect.
evidence_ref: DUPLICATE APPROVAL: one decision row per proposal, and the refused self-approval/stale attempts write none. DUPLICATE CALLBACK: a late resolve and a late human-input against an EXPIRED wait are both 409 and do not reactivate it. DUPLICATE COMMAND: a replayed append/createWait writes exactly one row (row counts, not response bodies). DUPLICATE DISPATCH: no dispatcher exists.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: stale plan/proposal/target version returns 409 and causes no mutation.
evidence_ref: STALE PLAN: 409 with graph_digest and version unchanged. STALE PROPOSAL: 409 PROPOSAL_STALE for a wrong payloadDigest AND for a wrong proposalVersion, with the proposal still PENDING_REVIEW at the same version and zero decision rows. STALE TARGET version (targetExpectedVersion against the mutated module object) is not exercised - there is no module object to mutate.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: timer and human waits survive a simulated multi-day interval.
evidence_ref: HUMAN wait: proven across a simulated multi-day interval expressed as data (dueAt 3 days overdue, timeoutAt 1 day overdue) rather than a sleep; it survives its creating request and is expired later by the scheduler. TIMER wait multi-day survival is not covered by this stream (claim/fencing races are covered by waitSubscriptionService.pg.test.ts).

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: late binding shows one module object and one Case link, never a copy.
evidence_ref: NEVER A COPY: proven - the Case holds a link carrying artifactType/artifactId/artifactRevision and an append-only revisionPinHistory; re-pinning to rev-2 updates the pointer and keeps the history, and no artifact content is stored on the Case. ONE MODULE OBJECT: the far end is an id only; no real module object exists to bind late to.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: UI, API and real database readback expose the same state and identifiers.
evidence_ref: API and REAL DATABASE readback are proven identical for every identifier and state in the chain (caseId, planVersionId, runId, actionProposalId, linkId, measurementId; case_status, closure_type, proposal status, link revision), read out of band through a separate pool. The UI third of this row does not exist.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: cross-tenant and revoked-membership tests fail closed.
evidence_ref: FAILS CLOSED and proven against real organization_members rows: cross-tenant read AND mutation are 404 and indistinguishable from a non-existent id; a REVOKED membership is refused (404 case-scoped, 403 org-scoped); a user with no membership row at all is refused. ONE EXCEPTION, pinned as a defect: cross-tenant Plays by-id leak existence via 403-vs-404 (CW-SEC-ENUM-PLAYS-01, playService.ts:761-763 and 1091-1097). This row cannot be PASS until that is fixed.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: audit reconstructs conversation -> Case -> plan -> Run -> NodeRun -> command -> proposal/decision -> artifact -> deliverable.
evidence_ref: PROVEN: one client-supplied X-Correlation-ID appears on ALL 19 events of the chain, and the exact ordered sequence Case -> plan -> run binding -> node acceptance -> proposal -> decision -> artifact -> deliverable pin -> outcome -> closure is asserted as an equality, not a subset. MISSING LINKS: conversation (no chat caller) and NodeRun (no NodeRun aggregate).

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: a legacy five-step AgentPlan round-trips to START + five nodes + END without loss of tool inputs or approval settings.
evidence_ref: No legacy AgentPlan round-trip path exists.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: Simple, Expert and List expose identical semantic node/edge IDs and graph digest.
evidence_ref: Proven for the EXPERT view: writing view state leaves graph_digest and the aggregate version untouched, so layout cannot fork the semantics. Not proven: that SIMPLE, EXPERT and LIST each expose the same node/edge ids - there is no view renderer to compare.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: List supports the same semantic edits and validation without drag-and-drop.
evidence_ref: No List view exists.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: an Expert branch survives Simple View without flattening or data loss.
evidence_ref: No Simple/Expert views exist.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: a stale graph save returns 409; a published graph cannot be modified.
evidence_ref: Both clauses proven on real PG: a stale-version graph save is 409 with the stored digest and version unchanged; a PUBLISHED plan rejects PUT with 409 PLAN_VERSION_NOT_EDITABLE.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: layout-only updates preserve semantic digest.
evidence_ref: A layout-only PUT to /plan-versions/:id/view-state/EXPERT round-trips the layout and leaves BOTH graph_digest and the aggregate version unchanged, asserted from the API response and from the case_plan_versions row out of band.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: every active palette entry resolves to an executable registry version.
evidence_ref: There is no palette. Worse, the registry cannot be populated over HTTP at all - POST /capabilities is unreachable (CW-API-CAP-ENUM-01), so 'every active palette entry resolves to an executable registry version' is unreachable from both ends.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: unknown/deprecated/unhealthy capabilities block publish with exact reason.
evidence_ref: Plan validation blockers exist and validatePlanVersion is routed, but this stream produced no test in which a capability is unknown/deprecated/unhealthy - because CW-API-CAP-ENUM-01 makes it impossible to register a capability over HTTP and then deprecate it.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: human and Teresa calls reach the same module command and validation.
evidence_ref: No Teresa caller exists (intake.routes.ts builds the contract; no chat route calls it).

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: direct and orchestrated operations create the same canonical artifact type.
evidence_ref: No direct-vs-orchestrated comparison is possible without module adapters.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: every mutation has successful canonical readback.
evidence_ref: Every mutation in all four scenarios is followed by a canonical readback taken through a SEPARATE pg pool, and the readback is asserted equal to the API response (never trusted from the response alone). Refused mutations are also read back and shown to have changed nothing.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: MCP/API callback replay produces one NodeRun transition and one effect.
evidence_ref: No MCP/API callback path and no NodeRun transition exist.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: artifact chips deep-link to the canonical owner object and exact revision.
evidence_ref: The BACKEND half is proven: a link resolves to the canonical owner (artifactType + artifactId) at an EXACT pinned revision, with the pin history retained. Artifact chips are UI and do not exist.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: API contract, schema and negative authorization tests pass on one SHA.
evidence_ref: API CONTRACT tests (109 operations, router-to-spec parity in both directions), SCHEMA tests (every $ref resolves; every operation has a success and a 500) and NEGATIVE AUTHORIZATION tests (cross-tenant, revoked membership, no membership, role gates) all pass. 'On one SHA' is unmet: the work is uncommitted.

requirement_text: Increment 10 (Golden Cases and production candidate) required flows: Golden B (direct Finance without Case -> late binding -> Teresa KPI and recommendation -> approval -> deliverable -> closeout); Golden A (mandate -> Interview -> Assessment/DRD -> Finance/KPI -> Recommendation -> Decision -> Initiative -> Execution -> Results -> Benefits -> Sustainability -> DOCX/PPTX). DoD/evidence: one exact deployed SHA and one canonical database; fresh migration replay plus idempotent rerun; API, browser, realDB, restart/replay and artifact evidence match the SHA; cross-tenant/project and revoked-membership suites pass; operator trace reconstructs the full causal chain; every gate is literally PASS, PARTIAL, BLOCKED, FAILED, EVIDENCE_MISSING or N/A_WITH_CODEX_APPROVAL (N/A valid only for literal canon out-of-scope or an immutable exact Codex approval reference).
evidence_ref: Increment 10 requires Golden A and Golden B as full consulting flows plus fresh migration replay, browser evidence and one deployed SHA. None of the module integrations those flows traverse (Interview, Assessment, Finance, Initiatives, Execution, Results, DOCX/PPTX) route through this API.

requirement_text: Golden Case A purpose: prove the system remains light. Flow: CFO intake -> financial source selection -> margin analysis -> sensitivity -> Findings -> Recommendation -> CFO review.
evidence_ref: Golden Case A of doc 10 is a CFO Finance flow. No Finance capability routes through this API.

requirement_text: Golden Case A must prove: Small/Lightweight Case path with no process theatre.
evidence_ref: The shape is proven on a LIGHT-profile Case: create -> activate -> one plan -> one proposal -> decision -> closure, with no mandatory gates or ceremony in between. The Finance content of the scenario is absent.

requirement_text: Golden Case A must prove: direct Finance capability and canonical Finance artifact.
evidence_ref: No direct Finance capability and no canonical Finance artifact.

requirement_text: Golden Case A must prove: reproducible calculations and source provenance.
evidence_ref: No calculation engine is invoked through this API, so reproducibility and source provenance have nothing to attach to.

requirement_text: Golden Case A must prove: assumptions and contradictory evidence visible.
evidence_ref: No assumption or contradictory-evidence model exists.

requirement_text: Golden Case A must prove: decision-ready result without mandatory Initiative.
evidence_ref: Proven: a Case reaches CLOSED with closure_type DECISION_COMPLETED and no Initiative anywhere in the chain. 'Decision-ready RESULT' is partial - there is no Recommendation artifact type; the decision trail and a linked artifact are what exist.

requirement_text: Golden Case A must prove: valid closure after the contracted diagnosis is accepted.
evidence_ref: Proven: the contracted closure axis is completed, recordClosure stores closure_type plus an evidenceRef, and only then does the Case transition to CLOSED - and a second recordClosure is 409. Not proven: that the 'contracted diagnosis' was itself accepted, since no diagnosis artifact acceptance exists.

requirement_text: Golden Case A failure shield: no invented baseline or ROI.
evidence_ref: No baseline/ROI computation exists to shield.

requirement_text: Golden Case A failure shield: no Case expansion merely because Teresa participated.
evidence_ref: The mechanism that enforces this shield is proven: proposing a work order creates zero Cases and zero Runs, and only an explicit human confirmation of the exact digest creates one. There is no Teresa participant yet to over-expand a Case.

requirement_text: Golden Case A failure shield: no document treated as proof of calculation.
evidence_ref: No document-vs-calculation distinction exists to enforce.

Flow: contract -> discovery/interviews -> assessments -> financial baseline -> options -> challenger -> Decision -> Initiatives -> execution -> KPI/benefits -> sustainability.
evidence_ref: TRANSFORMATION profile end-to-end lineage traverses modules that do not route through this API.

requirement_text: Golden Case B must prove: multiple roles, modules and memberships.
evidence_ref: MULTIPLE ROLES AND MEMBERSHIPS: proven - the chain requires two distinct ACTIVE members (a MEMBER who proposes, an ADMIN who approves and publishes), and the single-actor shortcut is refused. MULTIPLE MODULES: not proven, no other module participates.

requirement_text: Golden Case B must prove: progressive planning and material replan.
evidence_ref: Progressive planning and material replan (RequestReplan) have no command.

requirement_text: Golden Case B must prove: conflict-aware evidence.
evidence_ref: No conflict-aware evidence model exists.

requirement_text: Golden Case B must prove: proportionate independent challenger.
evidence_ref: No challenger role or command exists.

requirement_text: Golden Case B must prove: human Decision and exact approval version.
evidence_ref: The decision is made by a HUMAN other than the proposer (self-approval refused 403 SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN, and the proposal stays PENDING_REVIEW), and it is bound to an EXACT version: proposalVersion plus payloadDigest are carried and checked, and a stale value on either is 409 PROPOSAL_STALE with zero decision rows written.

requirement_text: Golden Case B must prove: Initiative ownership and execution readback.
evidence_ref: No Initiative object routes through this API.

requirement_text: Golden Case B must prove: KPI/ROI source lineage and attribution.
evidence_ref: ATTRIBUTION: proven as a stored, required field on a value measurement, alongside confidence and the measurement window. SOURCE LINEAGE: partial - measurements carry kpiRef/evidenceRef but nothing verifies the far end resolves, and no KPI module participates.

requirement_text: Golden Case B must prove: consistent DOCX/PPTX/XLS from one accepted facts digest.
evidence_ref: No DOCX/PPTX/XLS generation routes through this API and no accepted-facts digest is produced for it.

requirement_text: Golden Case B must prove: Monitoring Case split when the sustainability window exceeds delivery closure.
evidence_ref: MONITORING is an accepted caseProfile value, but no Case-split command exists.

requirement_text: Golden Case B failure shield: no self-approved recommendation.
evidence_ref: The self-approval attempt by the proposing actor is refused with 403 SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN; the proposal is read back still PENDING_REVIEW, exactly one decision row exists at the end of the chain, and it was written by the OTHER actor.

requirement_text: Golden Case B failure shield: no target presented as actual.
evidence_ref: Proven: baselineValue, targetValue and actualValue are distinct persisted fields and a measurement recorded with actual 6 against target 5 is stored with measurementStatus PARTIAL - the target is never written into the actual. Not proven: that no downstream surface presents one as the other, since no such surface exists.

requirement_text: Golden Case B failure shield: no final outcome claim before the measurement window.
evidence_ref: The measurement carries measurementWindowStart/End, nextMeasurementDueAt and a status vocabulary that includes UNMEASURED/PARTIAL/EVIDENCE_MISSING, and the recorded example is PARTIAL rather than CONFIRMED. No rule PREVENTS a premature CONFIRMED, so the shield is representational, not enforced.

requirement_text: Golden Case C flow: standalone Assessment -> Teresa gap synthesis -> LIGHT Case -> material investment Decision -> STANDARD or TRANSFORMATION Case with CONTROLLED governance.
evidence_ref: Standalone Assessment and Teresa gap synthesis do not route through this API.

requirement_text: Golden Case C must prove: initial Assessment works without Case.
evidence_ref: No Assessment module participates.

requirement_text: Golden Case C must prove: canonical artifact is referenced or pinned to an exact revision, not copied.
evidence_ref: The Case references the artifact by (artifactType, artifactId) and pins an EXACT revision; re-pinning from rev-1 to rev-2 updates artifact_revision and appends to revisionPinHistory rather than replacing it, and no artifact content is copied onto the Case. Verified in the API response and in the case_workspace_artifact_links row out of band.

requirement_text: Golden Case C must prove: promotion preserves owner, version and lineage.
evidence_ref: There is no promotion command from a standalone object to a Case.

requirement_text: Golden Case C must prove: governance tier increases before the material action.
evidence_ref: Raising the tier is proven and auditable: LIGHTWEIGHT -> CONTROLLED appends to governance_tier_history with actor and reason rather than overwriting it. NOT enforced: nothing requires the raise to happen BEFORE a material action - governance tier does not gate any command today.

requirement_text: Golden Case C must prove: earlier approvals do not authorize the expanded scope.
evidence_ref: Scope is not modelled, so 'earlier approvals do not authorize the expanded scope' has nothing to compare.

requirement_text: Golden Case D flow: Interview -> evidence -> option analysis -> challenger -> Decision: no action.
evidence_ref: The DECISION half of the flow is a passing Golden Case: option proposed -> reviewed -> rejected -> Case closed as DECISION_COMPLETED. The Interview, evidence and challenger stages are absent.

requirement_text: Golden Case D must prove: Case may complete successfully without Initiative.
evidence_ref: The Case reaches CLOSED with closure_type DECISION_COMPLETED, decision_status COMPLETED, and case_status asserted NOT FAILED and NOT CANCELLED - with zero Initiative and zero execution anywhere in the chain.

requirement_text: Golden Case D must prove: rationale, alternatives and evidence remain durable.
evidence_ref: The rejection reason, the deciding actor and the payloadDigest the decision was made against are all durable and readable back over GET /proposals/:id/decisions, and the alternative considered survives as the proposal row itself (status REJECTED, not deleted).

requirement_text: Golden Case D must prove: no fictitious ROI or execution result is created.
evidence_ref: Asserted as absence, out of band: zero value measurements, zero node result acceptances, no proposal.executing/executed/audited events, and the forced transition-to-executing is refused 409 with the proposal still REJECTED. The refused command emits nothing at all.

requirement_text: Golden Case D must prove: acceptance reflects DECISION_COMPLETED, not FAILED.
evidence_ref: closure_type is DECISION_COMPLETED and case_status is CLOSED, explicitly asserted not to be FAILED or CANCELLED.

requirement_text: Golden Case E flow: partial step persistence -> process failure -> restart -> idempotent resume -> expired approval -> reapproval -> completion.
evidence_ref: EXPIRED APPROVAL and IDEMPOTENT REPLAY halves are proven. PARTIAL STEP PERSISTENCE and PROCESS FAILURE -> RESTART -> RESUME are not: there is no NodeRun aggregate to persist a partial step against, and no resume command.

requirement_text: Golden Case E must prove: realDB state survives restart.
evidence_ref: State survives beyond the request that created it: the wait is re-read through a FRESH app instance and then out of band from Postgres, and is later transitioned by a different actor. This is not a true process restart - the node process is never killed.

requirement_text: Golden Case E must prove: no duplicate event or artifact mutation.
evidence_ref: NO DUPLICATE EVENT: no event_id repeats across a full chain, and the outbox primary key plus ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING is the producer-side dedup. NO DUPLICATE ARTIFACT MUTATION: replayed commands are asserted by ROW COUNT (one history event per dedupeKey, one wait per correlationKey, one Case per confirmed work order).

requirement_text: Golden Case E must prove: expired approval blocks execution.
evidence_ref: A proposal whose expiresAt has passed refuses APPROVE with 409 PROPOSAL_REVIEW_WINDOW_EXPIRED and also refuses transition-to-executing; the proposal is read back still PENDING_REVIEW at the unchanged version, zero decision rows exist, and no approval.approved or proposal.executing event was emitted.

requirement_text: Golden Case E must prove: retry history and correlation IDs are complete.
evidence_ref: CORRELATION IDS COMPLETE: proven - one client-supplied id on all 19 events of the happy path, and the scheduler's out-of-request expiry event is shown to mint its own while remaining traceable through aggregate_id/case_id/run_id. RETRY HISTORY: retryProposalFromFailed exists but no scenario in this stream drives a failure and retry.

requirement_text: Golden Case E must prove: operator and user see the same recovery state.
evidence_ref: There is no operator surface, so operator and user views cannot be compared.

requirement_text: Golden Case E must prove: compensation/rollback record exists where relevant.
evidence_ref: CompensateAction has no command and no compensation/rollback record type exists.

requirement_text: Golden Case F flow: user creates private Play draft -> validates -> test Case -> requests shared publication -> reviewer changes/rejects/approves -> immutable published version -> Case instantiation.
evidence_ref: Private authoring, version drafting and tenant-scoped cursor listing are exercised. The review -> publish -> immutable-version -> Case-instantiation tail is not driven by any scenario in this stream.

requirement_text: Golden Case F must prove: every authorized user can author privately.
evidence_ref: A plain org MEMBER creates process definitions (201) and they default to PRIVATE. Not proven: that EVERY authorized role can, since only the MEMBER role is exercised.

requirement_text: Golden Case F must prove: draft is absent from shared search/catalog.
evidence_ref: CROSS-TENANT absence from the catalog is proven: another organization's definition never appears in the caller's list. NOT proven: that a PRIVATE draft is hidden from other users WITHIN the same organization - and note that by-id access across tenants currently leaks existence via 403-vs-404 (CW-SEC-ENUM-PLAYS-01).

requirement_text: Golden Case F must prove: review evaluates governance, data, waits, failures and evidence.
evidence_ref: No review rubric covering governance, data, waits, failures and evidence exists; reviewProcessVersion records only APPROVED/CHANGES_REQUESTED plus a reason.

requirement_text: Golden Case F must prove: publication is versioned and audited.
evidence_ref: publishProcessVersion exists and process versions carry a versionNumber, a reviewHistory and published_at/published_by columns, but no scenario in this stream publishes one, so neither the versioning nor the audit trail is proven here.

requirement_text: Golden Case F must prove: rejected/requested changes do not leak a shared version.
evidence_ref: Not exercised: no scenario drives a rejected or changes-requested version and then checks the shared catalog.

requirement_text: Golden Case F must prove: instance edits do not mutate the Play.
evidence_ref: instantiateProcessVersion returns a Case plan DRAFT rather than a reference to the Play, which is the right shape for this guarantee, but no scenario edits the instance and then re-reads the Play to prove it is unchanged.

requirement_text: Golden Cases A–F pass without mocks substituting named runtime layers.
evidence_ref: WITHOUT MOCKS: fully satisfied - four Golden Case scenarios run over the real router, the real 12 domain services and a real PostgreSQL, with ZERO vi.mock of any runtime layer (only the JWT credential is substituted, as attachV8Context would have produced it). A-F COVERAGE: not satisfied - the scenarios that pass are a happy path, a refusal path, an expired-approval path and a wait-expiry path, which together cover Golden Case D fully and parts of A, B, C, E and F.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: the read surface a Golden Case leaves behind is actually readable - every list and by-id endpoint the API documents executes its real SQL against a real schema, rather than only being proven against a mocked service.
evidence_ref: PROVEN on real Postgres, 8/8 tests. A real Case + published plan version + bound run are created through the real API, then 22 list/read endpoints (org-, case-, run- and ADMIN-scoped) return the documented {data} envelope, 22 by-id reads for absent ids return a stable 404 with no SQL/stack leak, and a MEMBER is refused the ADMIN-gated quarantine reads (403). Closing assertion sweeps every observed status: NO endpoint answered 500, guarded by a >=45-observation floor so the suite cannot pass vacuously. Raises real-DB path coverage from 40/92 to ~72/92 documented paths.

requirement_text: Acceptance evidence: every documented endpoint is exercised end-to-end on a real database, not only through a mocked-service route test.
evidence_ref: PARTIAL - stated literally rather than rounded up. ~72 of 92 documented paths are exercised on real Postgres by the contract + golden-case suites. The ~20 that are NOT are all mutating lifecycle POSTs whose preconditions need a state this stream cannot reach without the process-version and capability-adapter surfaces: /process-versions/{id} propose|review|publish|deprecate|archive|instantiate, /process-definitions/{id}/share, /proposals/{id} retry|revoke|transition-to-failed, /plan-versions/{id} request-changes|withdraw, /waits/{id}/cancel, /cases/{id} cancel|autonomy-policy, /artifact-links/{id} mark-stale|mark-unavailable, /capabilities/by-id/{id} health|idempotency-check, /flags/org-state/{id}/rollback. Those 20 remain covered ONLY by the mocked-service route tests, which prove the route contract and nothing about the database. Structural parity for all 109 operations IS proven.
